# `aiinter`

AI labeling of Leiden populations and writing *_AIlabel columns

- Wrapper: [`job_ai.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_ai.sh)
- Conda environment: `imc_segmentation`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.ai_interpretation`

## Inputs

- process.output_adata_path (default anndata_processed.h5ad) with Leiden columns
- OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable (if visualization.enable_ai=true)

## Outputs

- process.output_adata_path (updated in place)
- general.qc_folder/AI_Interpretation/

## Configuration

- general, visualization, process, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl aiinter
```
